title: Paper planes
examples: How do I make my paper plane fly farther?
What makes a paper plane glide well?
Do I need to fold it perfectly?

explain.say: Today you will learn how to make a paper plane fly.
First, look at the wings of the plane. Wings help it stay up in the air.
Next, do the folding carefully. Make each fold straight.
Throw it gently, away from people.

draw.text: Gentle throw keeps the plane steady.

explain.say: Then watch it glide through the air and land.

draw.text: Gliding shows the plane's best flight.

explain.say: Real planes use wings to fly too.

faq.a: You throw it forward, and the air under the wings holds it up. So it can float down slowly.
asks: How do I make it go far?

faq.q: Should the wings be big or small?
faq.a: The wings need to be big enough to catch the air but not too big to make it heavy.

faq.q: Is it okay if my folds are not perfect?
faq.a: That is okay. Try to make each fold as straight as you can.
asks: Do they have to be straight?

faq.q: Do I need to throw it hard?
faq.a: No, throwing it too hard makes it wobble and fall down quickly.
asks: Should I throw it like a baseball?

faq.q: What is the best way to fold it?
faq.a: There are many ways, but folding it into a simple dart shape works very well to start with.
asks: Can you show me the best fold?

facts: Wings help create lift when air moves over them.
Folding helps give the plane a strong, stable shape.
A gentle throw helps the plane glide smoothly.
Gliding means moving through the air and slowly coming down.

quiz.say: Which part of a paper plane holds it up in the air?
quiz.why: The wide wings push against the air, and that holds the plane up.

wrong.1: The nose is the pointy front, and it cuts through the air.
wrong.2: The middle fold is where you hold the plane.

quiz.say: Mei throws her paper plane very hard. What usually happens?
quiz.why: A gentle throw keeps the plane steady. A hard throw makes it wobble.

wrong.0: A hard throw makes the plane wobble, so it comes down sooner.
wrong.2: A plane keeps moving until it lands.

quiz.say: What kind of folds help a paper plane fly well?
quiz.why: Neat folds make both wings the same, so the plane flies straight.

wrong.0: Messy folds make the wings uneven, so the plane tips.
wrong.1: Flat paper has no wings, so it flutters down.
